verdict.rationale: The GST system runs its own GST Developer Portal at developer.gst.gov.in/apiportal, with developer registration and login. That is first-party evidence that a public API programme exists. However, the evidence shows only the portal's home page, with no API references, endpoints, authentication flows or coverage of taxpayer actions, so how far an AI-native user could actually drive the product is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints and reference docs, evidence of which workflows (registration, returns, payments) are callable via API, access/auth requirements for public users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
